text:
sam: heads-up — hitting intermittent stalls in longctx runs on the H100/RTX mixed pool. KV pagewalk spikes when context > 60k tokens, tails blow up.

jia: can you paste the logs and perf output? :eyes:

sam: pasted minimal traces below, pattern looks like NVLINK tx bursts then a stall loop:
```
[perf] kv_pagewalk: 1203 calls, avg 0.9ms, p99 45ms
[hw] nvlink_tx_packets: 1.2M -> spike during stall
[rt] stall: wait_for_page: 318ms x 7 loop
dmesg: GPU 0 Xid 31 minor page fault remap
```

alex: similar to what i saw w/ hybrid nodes last month but only when async-evict + prefaulting are enabled. kernel selection changes latency profile — some kernels amplify pagewalk backpressure.

mira: my hunch: page-table remap ordering + reuse-window expansion -> transient double-alloc on the host shadow map. On NVLink the remote pagewalks create head-of-line blocking. Could be non-atomic shadow updates.

linda: quick mitigation that helped: force-local-alloc + disable-prefetch on dedicated canary, and drop batch size from 4->1. latency returns to normal. Not a fix but buys time.

sam: repro script: `./tools/repro_longctx --model llama2 --seq 65536 --batch 4 --nvlink-mix`. runs reproducible in ~10-30 minutes on canary.

perf-bot: uploaded flame/trace to s3://redwood-perf/2468012345/trace.html (public to team). nvprof snapshot shows pagewalk kernel waiting on memcpy and pci stalls.

mira: asking infra to try two experiments:
1) turn off async-evict in runtime (config: kv.eviction.async=false)
2) force single-GPU placement for longctx requests
both to see if stall disappears.

ops-bot: created ticket INF-2043, assigned to @alex and @jia. pinned logs and repro steps. tagging oncall.

jia: i'll run nsight on mixed nodes and collect cupti counters (page_fault_count, tlb_miss, nvlink_latency). also will instrument PT updates to add a small atomic seq id to detect races.

alex: if we confirm PT-remap race, short-term patch: serialize remap/update on owner tx; long-term: switch to atomic compare-exchange updates for shadow index. I'll draft PR.

sam: thanks — good plan. can we triage priority as P0 for Dedicated customers? stats show 0.3% error rate but high impact on tail-latency.

mira: ack. also add regression test in our perf harness that runs mixed NVLink scenario with reuse-window toggled — prevents future regressions. :white_check_mark:

linda: noted the workaround and perf-run commands in the ticket. I'll coordinate canary rollout for the mitigations.

sam: great. keep updates in this thread. once we have nsight traces i'll share the flakiness correlation matrix.
